verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for a browser-automation agent platform, so the axis applies. The pack shows no saved automation definitions, version history, diffs, or rollback. Run event polling and sessions only observe individual runs, and the V3/V4 labels are API versions, not user automation versions; neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
